sub_parameters.name: host
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the node.

sub_parameters.name: hostName
sub_parameters.description: The node name of the cloud-native ACK cluster. You can call the [ListAllNode](~~183958~~) operation to obtain the node name.

sub_parameters.name: nodeType
sub_parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node

sub_parameters.name: port
sub_parameters.description: The access port number of the node.

sub_parameters.name: zoneId
sub_parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance node. For example, the zone ID of Shanghai Zone C is cn-shanghai-c.

parameters.name: ignoreStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to ignore the cluster health status. Valid values:

- true: Ignored.
- false (default): Not ignored.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description:
The type of nodes to scale in. Valid values:

- WORKER: hot node
- WORKER_WARM: warm node
